style.backgroundSystem: deep pine-teal stage wall #0F4442 for hero and utility panels, warm off-white #F7F5F0 for process and trust panels, dark crumbly soil #3A2E24 for macro bands

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent earthy organic fertilizer home-gardening visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep pine-teal stage background #0F4442, warm off-white #F7F5F0, charcoal text #2E3532, fresh leaf-green accent #5FA052 and muted gold secondary accent #C9A86A for podium rim and thin dividers; soft studio key light from the front-left, controlled contrast on dark panels, bright even high-key on white panels, soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with short caption lines; consistent rounded rectangular info labels and numbered cards; consistent thin-line icon style; clean commercial product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright bag hero angle and scale; balanced breathing margins in every layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable upright bag hero angle and scale; grids use matched photo cards with uniform corner radius; balanced breathing margins in every layout
style.surfaceSystem: round display podium with gold rim #C9A86A, matte off-white board #F7F5F0, dark crumbly soil texture #3A2E24
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines with charcoal #2E3532 text on light panels and #FFFFFF text on dark panels; muted gold #C9A86A reserved for podium rim and thin divider accents
